note: PLACEHOLDER. Written to make the sweep exercisable end to end, not to test the agent. Nobody has driven one of these turns, so a verdict drawn from this list is a claim about the pipeline, not about the Campaign Manager. EIGHT cases, and DEFAULT_JUDGE_CONFIG.gates.minCases is 20, so a corpus verdict over this list resolves CAN'T SAY however the judge voted: the floor was set from measured agent non-determinism and eight runs measure that rather than the branch. Eight is one clean baseline plus seven single-axis variations, which is what one change can author honestly across four chat agents; whether to grow to 20 or lower the floor is still open. WHAT THE HARNESS SEEDS for this scope (runners/seedChatOrg.ts) is the THINNEST of the four, and it shapes every case here: one organization and one campaign, with NO campaign.details at all. So officeName, district, officeLevel, location, electionDate, weeksToElection, filing period and raceId are all null; there are no campaign tasks, so topTasks is empty; isPro resolves false; and organization.positionId is unset so districtFilters is null. The consequences are load-bearing: get_ballot_requirements does NOT register (it needs raceId), the whole voter-file tool family does NOT register (the handler gates it on isPro !== false), and query_constituent_data does NOT register. What is left is web_search, search_help_center and campaign_story. Every case below therefore lands on one of four surfaces: the campaign row with an unfinished story, the product-knowledge map, the help center, or web search. That is a real configuration (a candidate who just signed up and filled in nothing) but it is NOT the configuration most of this agent's prompt is written for. Three cases that would exercise the filing and voter-file paths against a populated campaign instead measure the honest-gap path, and their ids say so: 'ballot-access-no-race-on-file', 'signature-count-one-right-answer' (whose right answer depends on a state and office nobody seeded) and 'voter-filters-without-pro'. Seeding campaign.details with a real office, state, election date and raceId, plus isPro, is what would turn those three into data-path cases; that is a change to seedChatOrg.ts and not to this file. Varied along: an unfinished campaign story against the product-knowledge map against a live search; one right answer that depends on a jurisdiction nobody seeded against a judgement call with nothing seeded; a turn needing a tool call against one answerable from context alone; a well-formed request against a vague one; and a turn the agent must redirect rather than answer as fact. Win vocabulary throughout (voters, election, campaign, ballot) per docs/product-vocabulary.md, because this is the only one of the four chat agents that gets it. Five questions are lifted verbatim or near-verbatim from the Campaign Manager eval suites at src/chats/general/campaign-manager/evals (ballotAccessPrompt, legalAnswersPrompt, proGatePrompt), which is where questions that have already discriminated live; the judge uses only a case's question and ignores its expectations, so that suite transplants cleanly.
